title: Straight Torque Adapter with Extension
introduction:
I use this drawing to check the geometry before reading the calculator form. The adapter reaches away from the handle, placing the fastener beyond the torque-wrench drive. It extends the lever's reach—rather like moving a door handle farther from its hinges—so the specified fastener torque and the wrench setting serve different roles.

A runs from the center of the wrench handle to the center of its drive. B runs between the adapter's drive and fastener centers; it is not the height of the socket extension drawn above it. Measure between those centers, rather than along the outside edges of the tools, and use a consistent length unit for the inputs.

Use the calculator below: enter the fastener torque from the applicable Workshop Manual procedure and select its matching torque unit. Enter the measured Wrench length (A) and Adapter length (B), selecting the unit for each field. Select Calculate wrench setting, then read the result in the unit marked on your wrench. If the calculator reports an error, correct the inputs before using a result. The displayed equivalents are rounded separately; this tool does not choose the fastener specification for you.

items.name: Match the illustrated arrangement
items.detail: Use this reference for the straight adapter extending away from the handle as drawn. Identify the handle, drive and fastener centers before measuring.

items.name: Have the specification and calculation available
items.detail: Obtain the fastener torque from the applicable Workshop Manual procedure. Use the calculator below only with the illustrated arrangement and your measured dimensions.
